title: Thalamic Spindle Refractory Period Modulation via Thalamocortical Coupling
summary: Epileptic thalamic spikes increase the thalamic spindle refractory period, modulating thalamocortical coupling and spindle density during sleep.

title: White Matter Integrity Modulates Thalamocortical Spindle Overlap via Fractional Anisotropy
summary: This hypothesis proposes that fractional anisotropy (FA) in white matter tracts modulates the topographical patterns of thalamocortical spindle overlap, influencing the differentiation between slow and fast spindle subtypes during sleep.
